pages.title: The Guild Ledger
pages.text: Every workshop starts with a $(item)Guild Ledger$(). A forge needs four stations within 7 blocks of it across, and 4 up or down, set out however you like:

$(li)a $(item)furnace$() or $(item)blast furnace$(), to heat metal$(li)an $(item)anvil$(), to strike it$(li)a $(item)cauldron$() of water (or oil), to quench it$(li)a $(item)grindstone$(), to finish it$(br2)Read the ledger to see what's missing. Striking, quenching and grinding only work at stations near a ledger with a complete forge. One ledger serves every craft in its range.

Decoration counts too. Bricks, stone and deepslate bricks, chains, lanterns, iron bars, barrels and the like near the ledger widen every sweet spot a little: +0.5% for every 8 blocks, up to +2.5%. A forge that looks like a forge works like one.
